text:
fuck it, i decided to choose grok @bot instead..

codex or claude would cost me around $100, grok via cursor ultra is $200.

so i figured if i’m paying that much, this thing better do more than just writing code

so i gave it one job:

be my media buyer.

i connected it to my ad accounts, spreadsheets, analytics, and all the context about how i usually run campaigns.

then i told it not to bother me unless something actually needed my attention.

this morning it came back and:

• checked yesterday’s performance
• found a few ads burning money
• noticed one campaign where cpa suddenly jumped
• compared the losing creatives against the winners
• suggested what to pause
• shifted budget toward the better ad sets
• wrote new hooks based on the winning angles

then it sent me a summary explaining why it made those decisions.

i’m still checking its work because i’m not insane.

but if this thing can save or make me more than that extra $100/month, then technically going into debt for grok was a financially sound decision.

technically.
